title: types,react,skills,docs: retire the node-level visibility dialects visibleOn / hiddenOn / disabledOn / visible and teach only visibleWhen
body:
## 维护者速读

spec 18 的页面组件只声明 `visibleWhen`，表单字段/分区的 `visibleOn` 已是 `retiredKey` 墓碑。objectui 的节点级 `BaseSchema`、`SchemaRenderer` 仍读五个拼写，**发布给客户的 skill 把 `hiddenOn` / `visibleOn` / `disabledOn` 当协议教**。objectui#12654 / objectstack-ai/objectui#12692 / objectstack-ai/objectui#12696 只做了表单视图与设计器那一半。北极星：「退役立即生效，无过渡窗口、无别名双拼」「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句，等于产品缺陷」。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384, spec pin 915e9404)

- Spec: `PageComponentSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` declares `visibleWhen` only; `FormFieldBaseSchema` / `FormSectionSchema` in `view.zod.ts` carry `visibleOn: retiredKey(FORM_FIELD_VISIBLE_ON_RETIRED)`; no `hiddenOn` or `disabledOn` anywhere under `packages/spec/src/ui`.
- objectui: `packages/types/src/base.ts` still declares the members `visible`, `visibleOn` (JSDoc says deprecated), `hiddenOn`, `disabledOn`; `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` evaluates the chain `VISIBILITY_SHOW_KEYS = ['visibleWhen', 'visible', 'visibleOn']` and `VISIBILITY_HIDE_KEYS = ['hidden', 'hiddenOn']`.
- Reach: 39 non-test source files and 56 test files mention `visibleOn|hiddenOn|disabledOn` (command: `grep -rl 'visibleOn\|hiddenOn\|disabledOn' packages/*/src apps/console/src`, split on `test`).
- Published skill: the "Fields That ARE Evaluated" table in `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` lists `hiddenOn`, `visibleOn`, `disabledOn` as evaluated protocol fields; `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` gives examples for all three and its checklist item 4 explains the "On suffix".
- Docs: `content/docs/guide/expressions.md` has the sections "### visibleOn", "### hiddenOn", "### disabledOn"; `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` documents all three rows; across `content/docs`, 7 files mention `visibleOn` versus 5 for `visibleWhen`.

## Recommendation (one release batch)

- [ ] Remove `visibleOn`, `hiddenOn`, `disabledOn` from `BaseSchema` and its zod twin; leave `z.never` tombstones that carry the spec remedy, the same shape as the `dateField` / `endField` tombstones in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`. Keep `visible` only where the spec declares it (the tab row), per ADR-0089's note that boolean `visible` is a different concept.
- [ ] Collapse the `SchemaRenderer` visibility chain to `visibleWhen` plus `hidden`; `objectui validate` / `objectui check` refuse the three keys by name (they already judge through `StrictAnyComponentSchema`).
- [ ] Same PR series: fix `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`, `content/docs/guide/expressions.md`, `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, `content/docs/guide/schema-playground.md` (skills are a governed surface, so that PR waits for an authorised approval).
- [ ] Retire the 56 test files' dialect pins with the keys, or re-point them at `visibleWhen`.

Benefit: four keys that compile but the spec refuses leave the authoring face; customer agents stop being taught retired spellings. Effort M. Risk: stored metadata still written with the old keys is refused loudly, which is the intended behaviour; rollback is a revert.

Refs: objectui#12654, objectui#12692, objectui#12696, objectui#12770 (the form-view and designer half, done).

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
